description: Create a scoring key (no signup). One key covers all agents, identified by OTel service.name. webhook_url (https) is optional but recommended: it receives an HMAC-signed POST when any agent's score changes band.

purpose.description: Optional: 'test' for evaluation runs and benchmarks, so they stay out of KYDE's usage statistics. Default customer.

source.description: Optional: where you found KYDE Score (e.g. skill, llms.txt, registry, website). Aggregate adoption stats only.

webhook_url.description: Optional https URL notified on band changes.

name: create_key
title: Create scoring key
